checks.description: Every ASSETS.md table row has a numeric Size column
checks.cmd: python -c "import re; md=open('ASSETS.md').read(); rows=[l for l in md.splitlines() if l.startswith('|') and '---' not in l]; bad=[l for l in rows[1:] if not re.search(r'\\d+\\s*[xX×]\\s*\\d+', l)]; assert not bad, f'rows missing pixel sizes: {bad[:3]}'"
